verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a commerce and payments platform could plausibly offer event-triggered automation rules. However, the pack documents no rule builder or automation feature. The only related item is Square Webhooks (square-docs-12), and that is a developer building block for constructing automation, not a capability for defining rules that trigger actions, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
